Descriptions.Name: Overview
Descriptions.Description: This help menu includes the basics of all the commands and what they do in OpenLog

Descriptions.Name: Keyboard Shortcuts
Descriptions.Description:
Ctrl-Alt-C: Create
Ctrl-Alt-U: Update
Ctrl-D: Open Data Viewer
Ctrl-F: Get Flights

Descriptions.Name: New
Descriptions.Description: Creates a new log file and opens it in the window.

Descriptions.Name: Open
Descriptions.Description: Opens a .json log file in the current window.

Descriptions.Name: Save As
Descriptions.Description: Saves the current log file with a new filename and opens it in the current window. Leaves the old log file intact.

Descriptions.Name: Clean Flight Data Folder
Descriptions.Description: Cleans out old non-used flight data files out of the internal folder. Be careful, it can, and most likely will, break other log files that reference flight data files

Descriptions.Name: Export
Descriptions.Description: Exports the current log file as either a .json file, that OpenLog uses to save logs, or as a .csv that can be opened in spreadsheet software.

Descriptions.Name: Import
Descriptions.Description: Imports a .json log file into the current log file.

Descriptions.Name: Import Motor
Descriptions.Description: Can be used to import a .ENG (RASP) or .RSE (RockSim) thrust curve file into OpenLog.

Descriptions.Name: Update Log
Descriptions.Description: Opens a popup window that can be used to change the details of the selected flight, or a flight selected from the dropdown within the popup.

Descriptions.Name: Update Rocket
Descriptions.Description: Opens a popup window that can be used to change the details of the selected rocket, or a rocket selected from the dropdown within the popup.

Descriptions.Name: Update Electronic
Descriptions.Description: Opens a popup window that can be used to change the details of the selected Electronic, or a Electronic selected from the dropdown within the popup.

Descriptions.Name: Add Flight Data File
Descriptions.Description: Adds a flight data file to the selected flight. Currently only supports Eggtimer files (only tested on Quasar files), OpenLog Flight Data, and Fluctus Black Box files.

Descriptions.Name: Remove Flight Data File
Descriptions.Description: Removes a flight data file from the currently selected flight.

Descriptions.Name: Copy
Descriptions.Description: Copies the currently selected flight, rocket, or electronic.

Descriptions.Name: Paste
Descriptions.Description: Pastes the copied item into the log. When pasting a flight it also pastes the requisite rocket and electronic to the log if necessary.

Descriptions.Name: Preferences
Descriptions.Description: The preferences allow OpenLog to be adapted to what each person wants, and are saved between sessions.

Descriptions.Name: Data Window
Descriptions.Description: Allows the analysis of flight profiles directly in OpenLog without having to use other software.

Descriptions.Name: View Flights
Descriptions.Description: Shows a list of flights that use a selected rocket or motor.
